    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

        rows.setdefault(r, []).append(c)
    anchor_row = max(rows, key=lambda r: len(rows[r]))
    anchor_cols = rows[anchor_row]
    left, right = min(anchor_cols), max(anchor_cols)

        if out[anchor_row][c] == 0:

        if r == anchor_row:
            continue
        for rr in range(min(r, anchor_row), max(r, anchor_row) + 1):
            if out[rr][c] == 0:
                out[rr][c] = 3
    return out
